nodes.label: OpenCut Open Graph Card
nodes.rationale: Default social share card at apps/web/public/open-graph/default.jpg; serves as the fallback Open Graph image for unconfigured routes.

nodes.label: OpenCut Brand
nodes.rationale: Wordmark 'OpenCut' rendered in bold sans-serif black text, centered on the card; no tagline present.

nodes.label: OpenCut Logo Mark
nodes.rationale: Black hexagon/octagon glyph with a white square cutout, sitting to the left of the wordmark; the cutout evokes a film frame or cut window.

nodes.label: Video Editor Timeline Metaphor
nodes.rationale: Two faint solid horizontal rules cross the canvas like a video track; a vertical dashed line intersects them as a playhead/scrubber; a small scissors icon sits on the dashed line below the wordmark, reinforcing the 'cut' theme of the product name.

hyperedges.label: OpenCut Brand Identity
hyperedges.rationale: Wordmark, logo mark, and timeline/scissors visual collectively compose the OpenCut brand identity on the default OG card.
